unit.why: This is the opening of the 'Tiferet Moshe' section. It is a series of Torah novellae and sayings by R. Moshe and R. David of Lelov, arranged by weekly portion and quoted from other books (Tiferet Shlomo, Emet le-Yaakov, Beit Yaakov, etc.). There is no real narrative. The few frames ('I was with R. Moshe on Shabbat Korah, he said many times...', R. Fishele of Strikov who never believed a Jew sinned, the Yehudi accepting R. David's advice not to rebuke) describe habits or introduce sayings, not events.
unit.boundary_note: Division ends with the heading 'תפארת משה פרשת וישב', which belongs to the next division. That next division opens a story told by R. Yitzhak of Warka.
